title: linum alpinum subsp. gracilius
intro: Linum alpinum subsp. gracilius, commonly known as Alpine flax, is a plant species within the genus Linum, native to the mountainous regions of Europe. Alpine flax is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine flax include reducing inflammation, fighting bacterial infections, and stabilizing the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Alpine flax include linoleic acid, alpha-linolenic acid, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
